# buildkite_cluster_agent_image (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve a custom agent image for Linux hosted agents by its ID or exact
name within a cluster. Configure exactly one of `id` or `name`, alongside `cluster_id`.

The API token requires the `read_clusters` scope, and its user must have permission to
manage the cluster. Read access to the cluster alone is not sufficient.

This data source reports the current build status without waiting for the image to finish
building. Only use `image_ref` for a hosted queue when the image status is `READY`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "buildkite_cluster" "hosted" {
  name = "Hosted agents"
}

# Look up an existing custom image by its exact name within the cluster.
data "buildkite_cluster_agent_image" "by_name" {
  cluster_id = data.buildkite_cluster.hosted.uuid
  name       = "ruby"
}

# Alternatively, look up an image by its ID from the agent-images REST API.
# Configure either id or name, not both.
data "buildkite_cluster_agent_image" "by_id" {
  cluster_id = data.buildkite_cluster.hosted.uuid
  id         = "snb5nqcik8ge2"
}

# Use an image that has finished building (status = READY).
resource "buildkite_cluster_queue" "ruby" {
  cluster_id = data.buildkite_cluster.hosted.id
  key        = "ruby"
  hosted_agents = {
    instance_shape = "LINUX_AMD64_2X4"
    linux = {
      agent_image_ref = data.buildkite_cluster_agent_image.by_name.image_ref
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The UUID of the cluster the image belongs to. Use the cluster's `uuid`, not its GraphQL `id`.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of the agent image. Configure either `id` or `name`, but not both.
- `name` (String) The name of the agent image, matched exactly and case-sensitively within the cluster. Configure either `name` or `id`, but not both.

### Read-Only

- `dockerfile` (String) The Dockerfile instructions the image was created with, without the managed base image's `FROM` instruction.
- `image_ref` (String) The reference of the built image, for a hosted queue's `hosted_agents.linux.agent_image_ref`. May be empty before the image is ready.
- `status` (String) The current build status of the image: `BUILDING`, `READY` or `FAILED`. This data source does not wait for the build to finish.
